title: 第13章 照片引燃惊天风波第14章 帝京叶家
content_zh:
柳云烟的话音刚落，她的助理抬脚，一脚就把陈景言踹倒。
“狗东西，柳云烟这么尊贵的身子，岂是你一个傻子能随便触碰的。”
一个助理，竟敢踹他这个柳家的上门女婿，而且坐在轮椅上的柳云烟竟然视而不见。
陈景言的心直接凉到脚后跟了，怎么说他们也是夫妻，可在柳云烟的眼里，他简直一文不值。
他死心了，柳云烟甚至是柳家根本就不把他当人，他觉得自己不值得为他们做什么。
他缓缓从地上爬起，脸上火辣的痛感远不及心底的寒意。指尖轻轻擦过嘴角，那里渗出一丝鲜红。
血珠在唇角凝成一道暗痕，他却笑了，笑意如寒潭深水般幽冷。
他没有再看柳云烟和她的助理一眼，只是默默地转身，从衣柜里拿出他的铺盖，开始在地上铺床。
柳云烟和助理许靖韵诧异地看着陈景言的背影，仿佛不认识这个被她百般羞辱却始终沉默的男人。
柳云烟和许靖韵有些怔然，屋内寂静得连呼吸声都清晰可闻。
陈景言铺好床就躺下了。
黑暗中，他睁着眼，目光穿透天花板，仿佛在计算命运给予的每一道刻痕。
许靖韵搀扶着柳云烟躺下后退了出去。
柳云烟闭上眼，脑海中却浮现出陈景言那抹幽冷的笑意，心头莫名一悸。
她从未见过那样的眼神，有时候傻傻的，有时候明明温顺如羔羊，可就在被许靖韵踹倒在地上的时候，他的眼里突然间透出一抹可怕的神情，虽然稍纵即逝，但柳云烟感觉到了。
他可能是一头蛰伏的猛兽，隐忍而危险。
那抹笑意如同寒夜里的孤火，灼得她心神不宁。
柳云烟一大早就起床了，他洗漱好，来到餐厅，没有见到陈景言的身影。
餐桌上摆着温热的早餐，却不见那道熟悉卑微的身影。
管家在柳云烟耳边说道：“大小姐，姑爷还没有起床。”

柳云烟有些不耐烦地说道：“他没事，想睡就睡吧。别管他。”
陈景言睡了个自然醒，他起床以后，柳家人早就各忙各的，老爷子出去遛弯去了，家里只剩下保姆，没人理会他。
没有人为他准备早餐，他也不觉得意外。
柳家是江海市一线豪门，家里的狗都要比他这个上门女婿金贵三分。家里的保姆谁会在意他。
他径直走进厨房，动作熟练地煮了一碗面，坐下慢慢吃完。
然后出了门。
来到门口，保安不准他出门，说是柳家交代的，怕他走丢了，给柳家丢脸。
这些保安找到这份工作不容易，陈景言没有为难他们，他按照保安的要求，退了回去。
这个小小的柳家庄园，怎么能困得住他这个人间真龙。
柳云烟刚开完会回到办公室。
她的助理许靖韵便急匆匆走进来，把手机递到她的面前：“老大，你看。”
柳云烟接过手机一看，这是陈景言在街头摆摊算命的视频和照片。
他是柳家上门女婿的身份只是在少数权贵中流传，很明显，大家并不知道他是柳家的赘婿。
有人称他是小神医，能治一些疑难杂症，也有人称他神棍，骗人钱财。
content_en:
As soon as Liu Yunyan finished speaking, her assistant raised her foot and kicked Chen Jingyan down.
"Damn it, Liu Yunyan has such a noble body, how can a fool like you just touch it casually?"
An assistant dared to kick him, the Liu family's son-in-law, and turned a blind eye to Liu Yunyan who was sitting in a wheelchair.
Chen Jingyan's heart dropped to his heels. After all, they were a couple, but in Liu Yunyan's eyes, he was worthless.
He gave up. Liu Yunyan and even the Liu family didn't regard him as a human being at all. He felt that he was not worth doing anything for them.
He slowly got up from the ground, the burning pain on his face far less than the chill in his heart. The fingertips gently brushed the corner of the mouth, where a trace of bright red oozed.
Blood beads formed a dark mark at the corner of his lips, but he smiled, his smile as cold as the deep water of a cold pool.
He didn't look at Liu Yunyan and her assistant again. He just turned around silently, took out his bedding from the closet, and began to make a bed on the floor.
Liu Yunyan and her assistant Xu Jingyun looked at Chen Jingyan's back in surprise, as if they didn't recognize this man who had been humiliated by her in every possible way but remained silent.
Liu Yunyan and Xu Jingyun were a little stunned. The room was so quiet that even their breathing could be heard clearly.
Chen Jingyan made the bed and lay down.
In the darkness, he opened his eyes and stared through the ceiling, as if he was counting every mark given by fate.
Xu Jingyun helped Liu Yunyan lie down and stepped back.
Liu Yunyan closed her eyes, but Chen Jingyan's cold smile appeared in her mind, and she felt inexplicably frightened.
She had never seen such eyes before. Sometimes they were silly, sometimes they were as docile as a lamb, but when he was kicked to the ground by Xu Jingyun, a terrifying look suddenly appeared in his eyes. Although it was fleeting, Liu Yunyan felt it.
He may be a dormant beast, reclusive and dangerous.
That smile was like a solitary fire in the cold night, burning her uneasily.
Liu Yunyan got up early in the morning. After washing himself, he came to the restaurant and saw no sign of Chen Jingyan.
There was a warm breakfast on the dining table, but that familiar and humble figure was nowhere to be seen.
The housekeeper said in Liu Yunyan's ear: "Miss, I haven't gotten up yet."
Liu Yunyan said impatiently: "He's fine, just go to sleep if you want. Leave him alone."
Chen Jingyan woke up naturally after sleeping. After he got up, the Liu family had already been busy with their own affairs. The old man went out for a walk. Only the nanny was left at home, and no one paid attention to him.
He wasn't surprised that no one prepared breakfast for him.
The Liu family was a wealthy family in Jianghai City, and their dogs were three times more expensive than his son-in-law. Who cares about him as a nanny at home.
He walked straight into the kitchen, cooked a bowl of noodles skillfully, sat down and finished it slowly.
Then out the door.
When he came to the door, the security guard did not allow him to go out, saying that the Liu family had asked him to go out, and they were afraid that he would get lost and embarrass the Liu family.
It was not easy for these security guards to find this job. Chen Jingyan did not make it difficult for them. He followed the security guard's request and returned.
How could this small Liu family manor trap a real dragon like him?
Liu Yunyan had just returned to the office after a meeting.
Her assistant Xu Jingyun hurried in and handed the phone to her: "Boss, look."
Liu Yunyan took the phone and looked at it. It was a video and photo of Chen Jingyan setting up a fortune-telling stall on the street.
His identity as the Liu family's son-in-law was only spread among a few powerful people. Obviously, everyone did not know that he was the Liu family's surrogate son-in-law.
Some people call him a little miracle doctor who can cure some difficult and complicated diseases, while others call him a magician who defrauds people of money.
